Cristiano Ronaldo Leaves Portugal Camp Amidst Reported Rift

Cristiano Ronaldo has left the Portugal national team's training camp following a reported rift with coach Jorge Jesus. The departure occurred after the coach's press conference and subsequent talks between Ronaldo and FPF President Pedro Proenca. Portugal's training session resumed after a brief delay without Ronaldo. The incident has led to questions about Ronaldo's future with the team and resulted in a loss of approximately 500,000 social media followers for Portugal. Rafael Leao has taken the No. 7 shirt previously worn by Ronaldo.
